sourceAccessLimits: Actual completed author reads, not automatic proof from captures: all12 original family chunks,13 original older-body chunks,three supplemental mixed chunks and complete sports/休講 extra family renderings.

Original renderings were character-bounded, not byte-bounded. Their actual physical lines were read in bounded ranges; supplementary chunks are16000-UTF8-byte bounded. Preparation-plan statuses remain unchanged.

All104 original older bodies and17 supplemental older bodies were actually read. Direct complete sports and lecture-cancellation article reads add two identities; the union count and overlapping captures are computed explicitly.
All26 complete component records, four edited kanji bodies, unchanged 泊 and the complete487-line public rendering actually read. Missing 捉/兎/穫/身/丼 cards are not fabricated.

Twenty positive public captures all come from Digital Daijisen through Weblio: one dictionary authority, not20 independent authorities or fresh reviewer retrievals. Mixed headings are separated by exact spelling/reading.
Nineteen distinct principal families cover20 source rows; 中身 and 中味 share one new article. Seventeen articles are new, 泊める adds only N2 metadata, and 長い preserves its N5 identity and teaching.

Source-selected senses and additionally taught recognition senses are separate. Raw 治す repair glosses remain recorded but are not transferred into the medical family. 永い selects temporal sense2, not spatial sense1.

捕える retains the source identity while explicitly teaching 捕らえる/捉える and the とらえた form. Joint spelling evidence does not prove exclusive semantic compartments, naturalness of every collocation or measured frequency.

Exact old-body/label and source checks are author-executed. Declared exclusions are review hypotheses; title equality, grammatical category and neighboring exclusions do not determine every direct pair.
These reads do not establish native-speaker certification, official JLPT assignments, exhaustive corpus coverage, per-sense frequency, a live-quiz guarantee or independent reviewer agreement.

quizGuardRationale: Direct symmetric nontransitive hypotheses need independent review against actual full titles, older bodies and ordinary secondary senses in both answer directions.
Reassess catching/grasping/captivation, adoption/gathering/hiring, training/learning, duration/delay and interior/contents without inheriting a neighboring exclusion clique or a noun/verb exemption.
Keep exact-title equality dedup separate from semantic guards. Ordinary category/material relationships and different digits are not automatically synonym pairs.
sourceAccessLimits: Actual completed author reads, not automatic proof from captures: all12 original family chunks,13 original older-body chunks,three supplemental mixed chunks and complete sports/休講 extra family renderings.

Original renderings were character-bounded, not byte-bounded. Their actual physical lines were read in bounded ranges; supplementary chunks are16000-UTF8-byte bounded. Preparation-plan statuses remain unchanged.

All104 original older bodies and17 supplemental older bodies were actually read. Direct complete sports and lecture-cancellation article reads add two identities; the union count and overlapping captures are computed explicitly.
All26 complete component records, four edited kanji bodies, unchanged 泊 and the complete487-line public rendering actually read. Missing 捉/兎/穫/身/丼 cards are not fabricated.

Twenty positive public captures all come from Digital Daijisen through Weblio: one dictionary authority, not20 independent authorities or fresh reviewer retrievals. Mixed headings are separated by exact spelling/reading.
Nineteen distinct principal families cover20 source rows; 中身 and 中味 share one new article. Seventeen articles are new, 泊める adds only N2 metadata, and 長い preserves its N5 identity and teaching.

Source-selected senses and additionally taught recognition senses are separate. Raw 治す repair glosses remain recorded but are not transferred into the medical family. 永い selects temporal sense2, not spatial sense1.

捕える retains the source identity while explicitly teaching 捕らえる/捉える and the とらえた form. Joint spelling evidence does not prove exclusive semantic compartments, naturalness of every collocation or measured frequency.

Exact old-body/label and source checks are author-executed. Declared exclusions are review hypotheses; title equality, grammatical category and neighboring exclusions do not determine every direct pair.
These reads do not establish native-speaker certification, official JLPT assignments, exhaustive corpus coverage, per-sense frequency, a live-quiz guarantee or independent reviewer agreement.
